candidates.title: Conversation repair moves
candidates.learnerPain: Students do not know how to ask again, soften, or recover mid-talk.
candidates.curiosityHook: A few repair phrases make real conversation feel possible.

candidates.title: Polite but not weird
candidates.learnerPain: Learners overuse direct translations and sound too blunt or too formal.
candidates.curiosityHook: Politeness is a hidden grammar of social comfort.
candidates.firstPackShape: 12 MCQ items, A2-B1, requests, refusals, offers, thanks.

candidates.title: Tiny prepositions, big meaning
candidates.learnerPain: Learners keep mixing small fixed words in phrases they already know.
candidates.curiosityHook: A small word can steer the whole sentence.
candidates.firstPackShape: 12 MCQ items, A1-B2, fixed phrases only, no regional edge cases.
